Întrebări frecvente

What are The Flower Letters? ▾
The Flower Letters is a 12-month story experience that brings captivating stories to life through beautifully crafted letters mailed directly to you. Each story unfolds over the course of 12 months. Two letters are mailed each month for a total of 24 letters for each story.
What will I receive with my story experience? ▾
In each envelope, you will find heartfelt correspondence between story characters, along with thoughtfully designed extras like postcards, newspaper clippings, and other charming mementos that enrich the narrative.
When will I receive my order? ▾
Your first letter (or letter and tin) ships on the date you select during checkout. It typically arrives within 5-7 business days. After that, two letters are mailed each month on a regular schedule for the remainder of the year.
What is your return/refund policy? ▾
We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee. If you are not happy after the first two letters, let us know and we will issue a full refund, no questions asked. View our full policy.
